sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 370. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 90 seconds.
Only [Reliable Partner] Lloyd & Grim can be used as Unlocking Potential material
